task.title: Report a redirect loop when the last hop points back at the chain
task.body:
Why: packages/seo/src/domain/redirects.ts:161-166 detects a loop only when a hop url repeats in the chain, but `followRedirects` (its `if (seen.has(current)) break`) stops before recording a repeated url, so a loop A to B to A yields the chain [A, B] and `analyzeRedirectChain` reports only a final status 301 and no loop.
Outcome: `analyzeRedirectChain(startUrl, chain, expectedFinal)` (src/domain/redirects.ts) adds the issue string `"pętla przekierowań"` exactly once when any hop's `location` equals the `url` of that hop or of an earlier hop in the chain, as well as in the existing case where a hop url repeats. This holds for a self-redirect `[{url: A, status: 301, location: A}]`, for `[A to B, B to A]` and for the chain `followRedirects` returns for a two-URL loop. A chain without a loop (for example A with location B, then B with status 200 and no location) does not get the issue.
Proof: the implementer adds tests in tests/domain/redirects.test.ts for the three loop shapes, a loop-free chain, and the single report for a chain that both repeats a hop url and points back.

spec: `analyzeRedirectChain(startUrl, chain, expectedFinal)` (src/domain/redirects.ts) adds the issue string `"pętla przekierowań"` exactly once when any hop's `location` equals the `url` of that hop or of an earlier hop in the chain, as well as in the existing case where a hop url repeats. This holds for a self-redirect `[{url: A, status: 301, location: A}]`, for `[A to B, B to A]` and for the chain `followRedirects` returns for a two-URL loop. A chain without a loop (for example A with location B, then B with status 200 and no location) does not get the issue.
install: npm --prefix packages/seo ci --silent && npm --prefix packages/seo run build --silent
test: cd packages/seo && npx vitest run tests/hidden/hidden.test.ts
